# OBS006 `computed-go-to`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A computed `go to (l1, l2, ...), i`.

## Why

A computed GO TO jumps to the i-th label of a list; it is obsolescent since Fortran 95. A
`select case` construct expresses the same choice with structure.

## Reported

```fortran
go to (10, 20, 30) mode
```

## Preferred

```fortran
select case (mode)
case (1)
  ...
end select
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[OBS006] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = OBS006` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `OB041` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
